title: Phantom II
subtitle: Modified to Dock
text:
Grit
Action [1 resource]: If this card is a unit, attach it as an upgrade to The Ghost. (It's no longer a unit. Defeat all upgrades on it and remove all damage from it.)
Attached unit gets +3/+3 and gains Grit.
rules: If you use Phantom II's ability to attach it to a unit as an upgrade, defeat all upgrades on it and remove all damage from it. It is considered an upgrade while attached and it still has its text.
